items.evidence: "The journal has retracted \"Caffeine improves working memory in adults\". An institutional investigation found the data in Figures 2 to 4 were fabricated."

items.evidence: "The draft cites Brown and Kim [3] once, in the Introduction, as the reason for choosing a 200 mg dose."

items.fact: tells the researcher to remove or replace the citation and re-check the dose choice or claim
